study.question: Does the explicit positive-label force alone recover the true-label sign-source advantage when the prediction-dependent BCE force is removed, with native transfer geometry and private training fixed?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g3-r0030-joint_replay click AUC=0.668457307890924 versus g3-r0030-click_only=0.6678548720585206. At the later fixed-angle starting point, g3-r0070-full_source_bit_negative_bridge=0.6689610675617089 and g3-r0070-full_source_bit_positive_bridge=0.6683760511656333 give negative-minus-positive gap 0.0005850163960756; g3-r0070-zero_target_bit_negative=0.6686228172040088 and g3-r0070-zero_target_bit_positive=0.6685638448631844 give only 0.0000589723408244. These are single-seed local observations, not repeated mechanism support. The hypothesis is that the explicit current-positive-label contribution, rather than the prediction-only contribution, is sufficient to preserve much of the full-source preference for the negative transfer sign. At fixed recipient state write G_y=d sum_aux BCE(p,y)/dc and G_0=d sum_aux BCE(p,0)/dc. Test G_positive=d[sum_aux BCE(p,y)-sum_aux BCE(p,0)]/dc solely for the orientation bit. Away from saturation its logit cotangent is -y rather than p-y or p. The positivity-force source is distinct from the earlier true-minus-batch-mean-label deviation source. Success is not assumed; source interaction is an explicit alternative.

nearest_work.difference: The directly inherited seven-edge source-bit mechanism uses G_y or G_0. Replace only the source loss coefficients by (1,-1) to isolate the explicit positive-label force; retain (1,0) full-source bridges under both external signs. No whole-model architecture novelty is claimed.

study.proposed_difference: Four-cell factorial: source_component in {positive_label,full} crossed with orthogonal_orientation in {reversed,aligned}. For positive_label set source_loss=1*true_auxiliary_BCE-1*zero_target_auxiliary_BCE; for full use 1*true_auxiliary_BCE+0*zero_target_auxiliary_BCE. Differentiate the scalar combination through the original recipient graph BEFORE context VJPs are cast or reduced. This avoids subtracting already-rounded shared-context gradients. Every row, including empty-history rows, enters both source objectives to preserve Dice coupling. Detached source cotangents enter only the three bit collection edges through a value-zero surrogate. Real loss remains sum of four true-label BCEs; true auxiliary cotangents still determine native transfer radius/line/support. This isolates a first-order surrogate sign source, not the ordinary derivative of the reported scalar objective.
predictions: Bridge gate: same-sign full-source controls should reproduce g3-r0070-full_source_bit_negative_bridge and g3-r0070-full_source_bit_positive_bridge within absolute click AUC 0.000001. Forward values/parameter construction and true-label private gradients must agree at a fixed state to dtype tolerance; a mismatch blocks source attribution.

Define D_source=AUC(negative)-AUC(positive). Predeclared local support requires D_positive_label>0 and at least half of contemporaneous D_full (historical half-gap approximately 0.0002925), plus AUC(positive_label_negative) at least AUC(full_negative)-0.00015. These are practical descriptive thresholds, not statistical significance tests or claims of seed stability.

If fixed-state probes are available through the authorized host, positive_label probability cotangents on y=0 should cancel before Dice coupling; native radius/line/support and private gradients should remain matched at fixed state. A batch whose three auxiliary tasks are all-zero should give a zero positive-label source and the inherited +1 bit fallback. All-empty/zero-radius cases must keep zero transfer.

Optional fixed-state source_bit_diagnostics should compare native/source bits, active native-transfer support, radii and actual context-VJP difference. A source difference without active-transfer bit disagreement is not an effective orientation intervention. No diagnostic result is currently observed.

Capacity is expected unchanged at 32192421 parameters (31793216 embedding,399205 dense); host must remeasure training/GPU/wall time, peak memory, examples processed and four-task inference throughput/p50/p95 latency. Equal passes/capacity do not establish equal-compute efficiency.
falsifiers: Failure of full-source bridge reproducibility or fixed-state forward/private-gradient/native-geometry parity invalidates the isolated-source interpretation; retain costs and receipts and diagnose implementation before interpreting AUC.

With effective active-support bit changes and passing bridges, D_positive_label<=0, D_positive_label<0.5*D_full, or positive_label_negative AUC more than 0.00015 below full_negative fails the predeclared sufficiency prediction. Do not change these criteria after seeing results.

If positive-label source is frequently degenerate, bit disagreement is unmeasured, or tensor/numeric checks are unavailable, a null result is inconclusive about label information: report only the intervention outcome and missing diagnostic.

Even a passing single-seed contrast does not establish a general mechanism. Lack of advantage on permitted independent paired seeds would falsify reproducible benefit; same-seed bridges cannot supply that repetition.
alternative_explanations: One frozen seed only. Same-seed replay is a reproducibility bridge, not an independent repetition; extensive validation selection may overfit.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Reviewed current card and benchmark summary. task-aware token hubs and layer-wise gated broadcasts does not isolate the observed full-source versus zero-target sign gap; adopting it in this factorial would change forward capacity and confound source attribution. Prior knowledge-use record for INFNet/Zenith/HyFormer/TokenMixer/EST declared consideration with no executed variants; their effectiveness was not tested by those source-bit trials. Primary pinned INFNet source was inspected; other original-paper mechanisms remain unaudited. This is no rejection of their general utility.
